The matches were played in 12 venues in 12 cities across Brazil. The final match took place at the Maracanã Stadium in Rio de Janeiro on 13 July, the date of the 2014 Independence Day of Brazil. The tournament was won by Germany, who defeated Argentina 1–0 in the final, with Mario Götze scoring the winning goal in extra time.
